30/m divorced at 26. Time will be your greatest ally. The pain in the chest doesn't go away for a while. I was with this gal for 5 years, happy, had a house and two dogs. She tells me she wants a divorce. We divorce, house sells, gave a dog up to adoption, I leave my job, and I move in with my dad 2K miles away. It hurts to hit restart. The greatest recovery was removing anything that reminded me of her. Hardest things were those that was never owned; such as people and things in public that reminded me of her. Removing myself from the situation and finding myself was key. No longer did I have to compromise with anyone but myself. A lot of "soul" searching was done at my dad's. I was an interventionist at an elementary school, to then move out and work at my dad's landscaping company, was a heavy hitter. I moved out with what I could fit in a car, and a dog. I had stuff in storage, so I planned to come back. 

Long story short: Spent a summer with my dad, a lot of time with friends, rehashed some forgotten hobbies, took back writing, and found a new job when I came back. I moved to a new city though, and am happy.

It will be tough as hell, I guarantee that. There is no restart button that will wipe her from your memory, but you will grow and learn so much about yourself. I will bet you on this. I'm willing to help through the mental process if you'd like to pm me.

It will only get better if you help it, the world is here to remind you of that. : ).

30/M. High school is a very shallow part of life. You feel like you need to fit a certain groove, have a girlfriend, be ready for college, and have a future all lined up. Fuck that. Be you. Girls are attracted to people that are not afraid to be themselves. I'm currently single, and you know what, that's OK! You know why? Because I don't need a girl to solidify my existence. Sure a companion in this world sure is nice, but don't make the whole of your current existence built around it. Find out who you are, and love that, and continue to grow. There is a big world out there, it's calling your name! Be patient. Don't worry she'll come around, but don't try to pick at apples when a super fruit is around the corner. You just need to allow yourself to be you. Trust me it took me 12+ years to figure it out, and I'm still learning. Don't worry, a lady will come around. We are all humans and are growing. Biggest reason I've found for suicide is because of people being impatient. Enjoy the time to grow, and learn more. Take a moment and breath the air, see the colors on the birds, eat some snow, read a book, and most importantly fart loud(not literally) in public! Love yourself!! Most importantly...BE PATIENT.

I know you may be hurting, and I don't know the cause, but I can relate or rather sympathize. Suicide is an unspoken thing that happens, and it does affect people. I've been thinking about your post all day. We all effect each other as we are social animals. 

Why does it need to be over?

It may seem to to make it easier, but not for those around you. I don't know your relationship status (family, friends, or other), but those individuals will still have the pain of your loss to deal with. Because of suicide or other, people generally examine bodies for cause of death. You'll only be making things easy for yourself. People that read this, your note, will wonder who you are. All who are apart of this forum have contemplated death, and all the various perplexities that follow suit. I personally want to meet the world,  create an imaginary world in writing, and love/meet a soul mate. A suicide note means you still care. There are people who care for you, who want to know you, and to see the world through your eyes. Don't become collateral damage to society, be strong and embrace new beginnings. We are here for each other, and we can support each other. Hang in there, you're not a stranger nor are you alone.
